eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Summit, UT; at 2:57 PM on AUG 10, 2026 Effective until 3:57 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The area West of Main St. between East Canyon Road and South Henefer Road are in GO status for the fire. Evacuate Now. Follow designated evacuation routes. Contact 911 if assistance is needed to evacuate. Do not delay in order to gather additional belongings. A temporary shelter is open at the LDS Chapel at 40 N Main St. in Coalville. Additional information will be provided as it comes available at https://www.summitcounty.info/emergency and Utah Fire Info.
